name: Aiuchi Koharu
source:
Hobbies: Cooking, searching info about sweets

The protagonist. He is a very kind person who can't leave a person in need of help alone, and is particularly kind to girls, especially to his younger sister [url=/c33539]Hiyoko[/url]. Due to his mother's guidance - who is a professional gamer - he has mastered the skill of being able to play any kind of game there is. Because [url=/c33561]Polina[/url] found his intellectual playstyle and skills interesting, she decided to make him participate in Divine Crown Battle VR as the "king".
